kick.server_starting: The server is starting up. Please try again in a moment.
kick.auth_servers_down: Authentication servers are down. Please try again later, sorry!
kick.invalid_session: Invalid session (Try restarting your game and the launcher)
kick.misconfigured: Server misconfigured: see the server console.
kick.unsupported_version: This server supports Minecraft {versions}. You are on {client}.
update.check_hover: Ask the Pumpkin Market for the latest version
update.download_hover: Save the Market's signed Multiversion.wasm in the data folder
command.nothing_to_download: there is no newer version to download; run /multiversion update check first
command.asking: asking the Pumpkin Market; the result is logged to the console, and /multiversion update shows it
command.busy: an update request is already running
console.secret_rejected: Pumpkin rejected the forwarded identity: [networking.proxy.velocity] secret in pumpkin.toml must equal forwarding_secret in plugins/data/multiversion/config.toml (see plugins/data/multiversion/pumpkin-settings.txt), then restart
console.setup_passed_detail: Pumpkin is on {address} and accepts the players this plugin forwards
console.setup_unclear: setup check: Pumpkin answered the test login with: {reason}
console.setup_idle: Until then the plugin is idle and only this server's own version can join.
console.setup_needed_one: SETUP NEEDED (one time): stop the server, open pumpkin.toml and change this line:
console.setup_needed_many: SETUP NEEDED (one time): stop the server, open pumpkin.toml and change these {count} lines:
console.setup_each: Each is already in the file, under the heading in [brackets]. Save, then start the server.
console.backend_not_local: backend.address {address} is not a loopback address: other machines can reach Pumpkin's port directly, and the forwarding secret is all that stops them logging in as anyone. Use 127.0.0.1, or firewall that port.
console.language_auto: auto (English, and the game's own words where it has them)
console.language_missing: language = "{language}" has no file in the lang folder: players get English. Add lang/{file}.json or pick one that is there.
console.moved_messages: {count} reworded message(s) moved from config.toml to lang/{file}.json: messages are no longer settings in config.toml.
console.secret_empty: backend.forwarding_secret is empty; Pumpkin will reject logins. Set it in config.toml and pumpkin.toml.
update.console.off: update check is off ([updates] check = false in config.toml)
update.console.current: multiversion v{current} is up to date
update.console.downloaded_next: {path}. Stop the server and copy it over plugins/Multiversion.wasm.
update.console.fetch_hint: run /multiversion update download to fetch the signed file
update.console.nothing: there is no newer version to download
